p.i: Turbato cœpit Domino: Sveniúntque frequentes
Aligeri fratres, quæ tanti causa tumultus
Inter se rogitant trepidi, quæ litis origo,
Quos hæc ira notet: num totas fulmine terras
Perdere forte paret, num cœli extrudere cives,
Aut prisca reuocare chaos, quippe affore tempus
Audierant, ipsos olim quo Sverteret orbes
Cælorum, Sct totum flammis misceret olympum.
Cælorum in medio, quà se super omnia tollit
Sublimis moles mundum complexa rotundum,
Stat thronus Sct gemmis totus conflatus Sct auro:
Hic superum regidet Princeps, hinc singula cernē
Temperat æterno componitque omnia nutu.
Hunc geminæ circum dicuntur stare sorores,
Iustitia, Sct placido lenis Clementia vultu.
Altera districto cunctis velut ense minatur,
Turbatisque oculis testatur pectoris iras:
Altera blanditurque oculis, similisque precanti
Vertere commoti memoratur numinis iras.
Huc igitur postquam convenere Sndique diui,
Tu Pater iratus, Quaná hæc dementia? quanam
Improbitas, (inquit) nostrum contemnere numen
Mortales audere Sviros, Sct pectore ferri
Indomito auctorem contra? quid plurima fando
Commemorem? terraque datas totius habenas,
Et maris imperium: liquidóque Svolantia cælo?
Mentem ego diuinam tribui, quæ libera mortem
Depsiceret, quæ me, quæ cœli edisceret orbes.
Hoc cunctis commune bonum. Quid propria natu
Commoda

page.notes: Several words in the scan are blurred, especially at the right edge of lines and in the ornamental long-s-like forms; the "Sct"/"Sv" forms may be ligatured abbreviations of "et" and "ve" and are uncertain. Line-end words cut by the scan edge are marked only where clearly cut off. The catchword "Commoda" is the final word, set in the lower right.
